name: Asta

ASTA_TOKEN.description: Optional Asta API token for the asta CLI and skills; leave blank and run `asta auth login` instead.

postCreateCommand: if [ "${CODESPACES:-}" = true ]; then mkdir -p /workspaces/.asta-auth "$HOME/.config" && chmod 700 /workspaces/.asta-auth && if [ -d "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" ] && [ ! -L "$HOME/.config/asta-cli" ]; then cp -an "$HOME/.config/asta-cli/." /workspaces/.asta-auth/ && rm -r "$HOME/.config/asta-cli"; fi && ln -sfnT /workspaces/.asta-auth "$HOME/.config/asta-cli"; fi && npx --yes skills@latest add /opt/asta-plugins --all -g --yes

postAttachCommand.preview: if [ -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" ]; then url="https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-4848.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}/"; else url=http://localhost:4848/; fi; echo "Quarto preview: $url"; curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:4848/ || { [ -f Makefile ] && make preview; } || { [ -f _quarto.yml ] && quarto preview --no-browser --port 4848; } || true
